canaries.title: Pressure Definition
canaries.description_fingerprint: Thrust per unit area exerted by a fluid on a surface. \(P\)=pressure, \(F\)=normal force, \(A\)=area.

canaries.subject: Physics
canaries.title: Gauge Pressure
canaries.description_fingerprint: Pressure relative to atmosphere at depth \(h\) in a liquid. \(P_{abs}\)=absolute pressure, \(P_0\)=atmospheric pressure, \(\rho\)=density, \(h\)=depth.

canaries.subject: Physics
canaries.title: Pressure at Same Level
canaries.description_fingerprint: Hydrostatic paradox: pressure is equal at all points at the same depth in a connected fluid at rest. \(P_A, P_B\)=pressures at two points at equal height.
